verdict.rationale: Unleash ships an official MCP server so LLM-powered coding assistants can create and manage feature flags. That gives natural-language operation, but only through an external AI assistant, not a native natural-language interface in the product. Nothing shows which operations beyond flag creation and management are covered. Missing for 10: built-in natural-language command interface in the Admin UI, documented coverage of operations beyond flag create/manage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/mcp
